item.title: Week 10: Texans at Browns
item.description: Sun 11/15 · 1:00 PM ET | Line: HOU -4.5 · O/U 40.5 | Model CLE 47% vs. market 36% | On paper this is close, with Houston's strongest edge its passing game, ranked 6th in EPA per dropback (+0.22), while Cleveland's best counter is its 1st-ranked stuff rate (18% generated) at the point of attack. C.J. Stroud ranks 6th of 31 in EPA per dropback against Deshaun Watson's 24th of 31, and Houston's x-factor is Dalton Schultz, who averages 3.9 yards of separation (6th of 76) against a Cleveland pass defense ranked 13th. The model favors Houston at 53% win probability, driven mainly by the starting QB (+2.3 points) and the passing matchup (+2.1 points).
